# cycle_autoscale_group (Resource)

Manages a Cycle auto-scale group (`POST /v1/infrastructure/auto-scale/groups`). The group describes which server models and locations Cycle may provision from, and the scale-up / scale-down bounds.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cycle_autoscale_group" "workers" {
  name       = "Workers"
  identifier = "workers"
  cluster    = "production"

  infrastructure = [
    {
      provider       = "equinix-metal"
      model_id       = var.model_id
      integration_id = var.provider_integration_id
      priority       = 1
      locations = [
        {
          id                 = var.location_id
          availability_zones = []
        }
      ]
    }
  ]

  scale = {
    up = {
      maximum = 3
    }
    down = {
      inactivity_period = "1h"
      method            = "fifo"
      min_ttl           = "24h"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster` (String) The identifier of the cluster this auto-scale group belongs to. Changing this forces a new group to be created.
- `identifier` (String) A human-readable slugged identifier for the auto-scale group.
- `infrastructure` (Attributes List) Ordered list of server models Cycle may provision from. Lower `priority` values are preferred. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--infrastructure))
- `name` (String) A user-defined name for the auto-scale group.
- `scale` (Attributes) Scale-up and scale-down bounds for the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scale))

### Read-Only

- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this auto-scale group belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the auto-scale group.
- `state` (String) The current state of the auto-scale group.

<a id="nestedatt--infrastructure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `infrastructure`

Required:

- `locations` (Attributes List) Locations (and optional availability zones) this model may be provisioned in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--infrastructure--locations))
- `model_id` (String) The provider server model ID to provision.
- `priority` (Number) Relative priority of this model. Lower numbers are chosen first.
- `provider` (String) The infrastructure provider identifier (e.g. the vendor slug used by the integration).

Optional:

- `integration_id` (String) The provider integration ID associated with this model.

<a id="nestedatt--infrastructure--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `infrastructure.locations`

Required:

- `id` (String) The provider location ID.

Optional:

- `availability_zones` (List of String) Availability zones within the location. An empty list means any zone.



<a id="nestedatt--scale"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scale`

Required:

- `up` (Attributes) Scale-up settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scale--up))

Optional:

- `down` (Attributes) Scale-down settings. Duration fields use Cycle duration strings (e.g. `1h`, `24h`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scale--down))

<a id="nestedatt--scale--up"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scale.up`

Required:

- `maximum` (Number) Maximum number of servers this group may provision.


<a id="nestedatt--scale--down"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scale.down`

Optional:

- `inactivity_period` (String) How long after the last instance is deployed before a server is eligible for deletion.
- `method` (String) Which server to remove first when scaling down. One of `fifo` or `lifo`.
- `min_ttl` (String) Minimum time-to-live for a server provisioned by an autoscale event.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Auto-scale groups are imported using their ID.
terraform import cycle_autoscale_group.workers 651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21
```
